about: The demos `alpha demo` can launch. Alpha never links these — add or remove an entry here and Alpha needs no recompile. Each demo runs via its cargo `package` in a source checkout, or a prebuilt `bin` path for an installed alpha (bin wins over package if both are set; a relative bin resolves against this file's directory).

demos.name: walkthrough
demos.summary: Onboarding loop: author -> build -> sign -> load -> run -> migrate, narrated.

demos.name: federation
demos.summary: Many Sanctums x Realms over ed25519 TCP (loopback). ALPHA_DURABLE_BESTIARY=1 runs it on the durable Bestiary.

demos.name: distribute
demos.summary: Two Sanctums over ed25519 TCP (loopback): A publishes a creature, B fetch-loads it in bounded GX chunks with one `registry fetch-load` command, then runs it.

demos.name: bestiary-live
demos.summary: A REAL model authors a creature into a durable, replicated, AI-curated Bestiary (opt-in: needs ALPHA_LLM_MODEL + --features openai).
